posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
I think your best option would be to request a custom plugin that reads a notetag to determine which switch to turn on, and do so at the beginning of the skill sequence.
There are other ways to turn a switch without a plugin, but they would all cause timing problems - for example the combination of instand cast and force action would have the switches go on long before the skill action (due to turn-based), damage coding would only trigger near the end of the skill action and so on.
You might want to compare this to decide when the best moment for the switch will be, and then tell that in the plugin request:
RPG Maker VXA/MV/MZ Damage Flow

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
removing lines from a plugin can cause a lot more problems, it is never a real solution.
you should have asked the plugin programmer
@ATT_Turan
to check the problem.
EDIT: did you start a new game after adding the plugin? "undefined" errors are often caused by incompatible older savefiles.
